Nagel et al. 2024 Replication Package Documentation

This package produces the content of Nagel et al. (2024). Running the package directly will execute __main__.py, which simultaneously executes its submodules and with it all results:

$ python src/pfd

The submodules shape_data.py, run_estimation.py, and create_descriptives.py can also sequentially be executed individually to reproduce only certain parts of the paper because submodules depend on previous ones.

The random seed is globally set once for each program in the file conf/config.yaml, which contains parameters used by all programs. These variables can be modified by adding .yaml files like conf/general/alt_seed.yaml, which override the default configurations. However, there is no need to change any global variables.

Warning

The current appearance settings of tables and figures may not perfectly fit the output with changed seeds.
